column1: Mesin Rust belum disertakan di build ini. Cara menambahkannya ada di docs/rust-engine.md.
column2: Engine Rust ch\u01b0a \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c \u0111\u01b0a v\u00e0o b\u1ea3n build n\u00e0y. C\u00e1ch th\u00eam: docs/rust-engine.md.

column1: Mesin Rust butuh Android 9 (API 28) ke atas.
column2: Engine Rust y\u00eau c\u1ea7u Android 9 (API 28) tr\u1edf l\u00ean.

column1: Mesin Rust hanya tersedia untuk HP 64-bit (arm64).
column2: Engine Rust ch\u1ec9 d\u00f9ng \u0111\u01b0\u1ee3c tr\u00ean \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i 64-bit (arm64).

column1: RAM HP ini terbatas untuk mesin Rust (disarankan 4 GB ke atas). Game bisa tertutup sendiri.
column2: RAM c\u1ee7a \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i n\u00e0y kh\u00e1 h\u1ea1n ch\u1ebf \u0111\u1ed1i v\u1edbi engine Rust (khuy\u1ebfn ngh\u1ecb t\u1eeb 4 GB tr\u1edf l\u00ean). Game c\u00f3 th\u1ec3 t\u1ef1 tho\u00e1t.

column1: Mesin Rust menggantikan seluruh client Java Minecraft: tanpa Java, tanpa mod Fabric, Forge, atau NeoForge.
column2: Engine Rust thay th\u1ebf to\u00e0n b\u1ed9 client Java c\u1ee7a Minecraft: kh\u00f4ng c\u1ea7n Java v\u00e0 kh\u00f4ng d\u00f9ng mod Fabric, Forge hay NeoForge.

column1: Hanya mendukung Minecraft {0}. Sumber daya game (sekitar 500 MiB) diunduh mesinnya sendiri saat pertama dibuka.
column2: Ch\u1ec9 h\u1ed7 tr\u1ee3 Minecraft {0}. Ch\u00ednh engine s\u1ebd t\u1ea3i t\u00e0i nguy\u00ean game (kho\u1ea3ng 500 MiB) \u1edf l\u1ea7n m\u1edf \u0111\u1ea7u ti\u00ean.

column1: Eksperimental: butuh Android 9 ke atas dan HP 64-bit.
column2: Th\u1eed nghi\u1ec7m: y\u00eau c\u1ea7u Android 9 tr\u1edf l\u00ean v\u00e0 \u0111i\u1ec7n tho\u1ea1i 64-bit.
